newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 6,220 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 6,220 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 6,220 contracts compared with 2,193 overnight Thursday.
There were 334 wheat, 4,209 corn, 1,498 soybean, 50 soymeal, 36 soyoil, two rice, 42 corn calls, 31 corn puts, 13 soybean calls and five soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was three to 4-1/2 cents higher, corn was 3-1/2 to six cents higher and soybeans were 10 to 18-3/4 cents higher.
